modules.title: 一次请求里，你的提示词在哪一层
把提示词写具体的三件事

items.title: 明确包含范围与排除约束
items.text: 「先不做统计图」「不要加登录」这类排除项，能防止 AI 自作主张把工具做大。

items.title: 给出能检查的完成标准
items.text: 「手机上也能用」「能新增能改能删」——AI 和你验收时都有同一把尺子。

items.title: 单轮聚焦单一改动目标
items.text: 一轮改太多处，出错就不知道是哪句引起的。一轮改一处，验证完再下一轮。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 提示词是你每次发给 AI 的话；系统提示词是做这个工具的人预设的「AI 岗位说明书」，你通常看不见、也改不了，两者是请求里的两层。提示词也不等于上下文工程：前者是你写的这一段话，后者是把资料、记忆和规则整套管理起来的方法。改提示词是最快的第一步；改了还不行，再去检查上下文里缺了什么资料。

lessonPractice.title: AI 做出来的东西和想的不一样，第一步应该做什么？

options.label: 把要求说得更具体：对象、字段、怎样算完成
options.feedback: 对。AI 是按提示词工作的，结果偏了多半是提示词里缺信息。补上「要什么、不要什么、怎么验收」，下一轮就准了。

options.label: 立刻换一个 AI 工具试试
options.feedback: 换工具解决不了信息缺失：同样的模糊要求，换一个 AI 还是只能猜。先把话说清通常更快。

options.label: 反复说「不对，重做」，等它自己领会
options.feedback: 「不对」没有告诉 AI 哪里不对。每轮重做都在烧时间和额度，不如一句话说清要改哪里。

en.title: The AI's result is not what you wanted. What should you do first?

options.label: Make the request specific: object, fields, and what counts as done
options.feedback: Correct. The AI works from your prompt; off-target results usually mean missing information. Add "what, what not, and how to verify."

options.label: Switch to a different AI tool right away
options.feedback: A different tool still has to guess from the same vague request. Clarifying is almost always faster.

options.label: Keep saying "wrong, redo it" until it gets you
options.feedback: "Wrong" does not say what is wrong. Each redo burns time and quota; one specific sentence beats ten vague ones.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 写提示词的一个顺手模板
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 做什么（客户报价列表）＋ 有哪些字段（客户名、金额、日期、状态）＋ 不要什么（先不做统计图）＋ 怎么算完成（能新增能改能删，手机上也能用）。不用每次全填，但结果越重要，说得越全。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Build a client quote list with client name, amount, date, and status, stored in the browser for now. Skip charts and export this round. Done means: add, edit, and delete all work, and it works on mobile too.

learning.assumes: You have chatted with an AI and asked it to build something.
learning.outcome: You reach for the prompt first when results are off (add object, requirements, done-criteria), and you separate prompts from system prompts.

modules.title: Where your prompt sits inside a request
Three things that make a prompt concrete

items.title: Say what you want—and what you don't
items.text: Exclusions like "no charts yet" or "no login" stop the AI from growing the tool on its own.

items.title: Give checkable done-criteria
items.text: "Works on mobile" and "add, edit, delete all work" give you and the AI the same ruler.

items.title: One round, one change
items.text: Changing many things at once hides which sentence caused the error. Change one, verify, then continue.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Your prompt is the message you send each time; the system prompt is the developer-preset "job description" you cannot see or edit—two layers of one request. Prompting is also not context engineering: the former is this one message, the latter manages sources, memory, and rules as a whole. Refining the prompt is the first lever—cheap and immediate; its ceiling is set by what the context holds.

distinctions.label: System Prompt
distinctions.text: {c:system-prompt} is the developer-preset role the user cannot see; {c:prompt} is what you write in each turn.

distinctions.label: Context Engineering
distinctions.text: {c:prompt} is one message you write; {c:context-engineering} manages the whole set of sources, memory, and rules.
